components.text: When adding an operation, define a clear OpDefinition and Codec first, then keep execution inside the runtime class. The registry scans @RegisteredOp classes under com.astune.

pages.text:
• IDs must be stable and use the gyromancy namespace to protect saves and caches.
• Keep match specific; use accepted to declare consumable extra inputs.
• Return CompileResult.Failure with readable diagnostics; do not use null for failure.
